2610.09558.title: DrugTargetWorld: A Synthetic Biobank for Training and Benchmarking AI Scientists
2610.09558.paper_summary: Drug target discovery requires distinguishing molecules that causally drive disease from those that are merely associated with it. Training and evaluating AI agents to perform this workflow end-to-end is difficult because real world biobanks lack known causal ground truth and participant-level data is access controlled. We introduce DrugTargetWorld, a framework that procedurally generates simulated biobanks, or "worlds," with known but concealed causal structure. Each world contains genotypes, proteins, health records, outcomes, and synthetic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for 54,000 participants. Agents must construct a disease phenotype, identify causal driver proteins, infer the beneficial direction of modulation, and optionally conduct virtual 'wet lab' experiments. We evaluated nine agents in 540 episodes across 20 cardiovascular worlds and three experimental budgets. Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol achieved the highest mean composite scores, 39.98 and 35.38 of 100, respectively, and both recovered 64% of causal drivers on average. However, no agent reliably distinguished misleading non-causal proteins, and performance remained limited by the integrative judgments required to connect phenotype construction, causal evidence, and intervention decisions. By making each world's causal structure known to the evaluator but hidden from the agent, DrugTargetWorld turns end-to-end drug target discovery into a scalable training and evaluation problem with verifiable reward.
2610.09558.paper_summary_zh: 藥物靶點發現需要區分那些因果驅動疾病的分子與那些僅僅與之相關的分子。訓練和評估 AI 代理人以端到端執行此工作流程是困難的，因為現實世界的生物銀行缺乏已知的因果真相，且參與者層級的數據受到訪問控制。我們介紹了 DrugTargetWorld，一個程序生成模擬生物銀行或“世界”的框架，具有已知但隱藏的因果結構。每個世界包含 54,000 名參與者的基因型、蛋白質、健康記錄、結果和合成的磁共振成像 (MRI)。代理人必須構建疾病表型，識別因果驅動蛋白，推斷調節的有益方向，並可選擇進行虛擬的“濕實驗室”實驗。我們在 20 個心血管世界和三個實驗預算中評估了九個代理人，共 540 集。Opus 5 和 GPT-5.6 Sol 獲得了最高的平均綜合得分，分別為 39.98 和 35.38（滿分 100），並且平均恢復了 64% 的因果驅動因子。然而，沒有任何代理人能可靠地區分誤導性的非因果蛋白，且性能仍然受到連接表型構建、因果證據和干預決策所需的綜合判斷的限制。通過使每個世界的因果結構對評估者已知但對代理人隱藏，DrugTargetWorld 將端到端的藥物靶點發現轉變為一個可擴展的訓練和評估問題，並具有可驗證的獎勵。
